name: Bessie Irene Cantrell (Simons)
sources: Obituary of Irene Simons, Tri-City Herald, 15 Oct 2017 (Legacy.com)
notes: Born Bessie Irene Cantrell on 4 Nov 1932 at Rock Island, Tennessee, the eldest of three daughters of Hallie and Houston Cantrell; the family moved to Washington in 1942. She married her high school sweetheart Orvel Keith Simons in 1951 and raised their four children, Janine, Les, Rod and Billy, after his death in 1979. Known to her grandchildren as "Gam". She died 10 Oct 2017, a long-time Pasco resident.
